clauses.AT-1: Inpatient treatment estimates up to THB 180,000 per case may be submitted for pre-check.
clauses.AT-2: For an estimate of THB 50,000 or more, attach a breakdown with each service and its price.
clauses.AT-3: Attach the planned procedure, admission date and member reference to every request.

clauses.MM-1: Submit the planned procedure, member reference, admission date and itemized estimate.
clauses.MM-2: Procedures performed solely for cosmetic appearance are excluded.
clauses.MM-3: The inpatient estimate limit is THB 220,000 per case.
